name: Meaning
source:
Sol Fitzroy is finally living with the love of her life, Chet Chester. The high school sweethearts are happily domestic, and every day is full of warm cuddles and sweet kisses.

But when her estranged cousin writes to her, Sol learns that the family business wants her back. Poised to inherit the multi-million dollar soup company, her parents will do anything so she joins Fitzroy Foods.

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/meaning]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
索尔·菲茨罗伊终于与她一生的挚爱切特·切斯特生活在一起。高中情侣们过着幸福的家庭，每天都充满了温暖的拥抱和甜蜜的亲吻。

但当她疏远的表弟写信给她时，索尔得知家族企业希望她回来。为了继承这家价值数百万美元的汤品公司，她的父母愿意做任何事，所以她加入了菲茨罗伊食品公司。

[来自[url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/meaning]Itch.io[/url]]
